rootCause.summary: Writer Reasoning existed as a pre-draft plan, but standard/deep articles could still silently fall back to generic body generation when the plan writer returned a thin or empty body. This allowed preventable reasoning failures to become downstream editorial and repair work.
symptoms: Plan exists but generic prose can be generated after plan failure.
Worker slices can replace thin plan-based prose with generic body paragraphs.
Headline creation has multiple parallel routes that can bypass the same canonical story identity.

changesApplied.change: Added a strict plan-only gate for standard and deep articles.
changesApplied.effect: If plan-based prose is missing, thin, or fails plan verification, the story returns to targeted Writer Reasoning recovery instead of silently falling back to generic writing.

changesApplied.change: Writer Reasoning failures now record NEEDS_WRITER_REASONING recovery entries with reason, blockers, body length, paragraph count, and prevention lesson.
changesApplied.effect: The Brain can identify and repair the actual reasoning gap rather than treating the resulting draft as a generic editorial rejection.

changesApplied.change: Added a canonical headline service used by the full builder and worker slices.
changesApplied.effect: Headline candidates are selected from locked dossier, canonical identity, completed body, and Writer Reasoning evidence instead of allowing each path to invent a separate headline behavior.

preventionRule: Standard and deep articles must pass through locked dossier -> Writer Reasoning plan -> plan-based body -> plan verification -> canonical headline service. If any step fails, return to targeted recovery before editor review; do not fall back to generic body generation.

expectedImpact.firstPassPublication: increase after generic fallback drafts are prevented
expectedImpact.repairLoopsPerArticle: decrease because standard/deep failures are recovered before editor review
expectedImpact.headlineWordSalad: decrease as full builder and worker slices share one canonical headline service
expectedImpact.cpuPerVisibleArticle: decrease by avoiding downstream repairs caused by plan/body mismatch

runtimeSignalsToWatch: NEEDS_WRITER_REASONING recovery records should appear instead of weak standard/deep generic drafts.
writerReasoningDraftVerificationsPassed should rise for standard/deep articles that reach editor review.
headlineAudit.action should show canonical-headline-service or worker-slice-canonical-headline-service on new stories.
